shared_elements: low-relief motifs carved on a tall, narrow vertical slab/pillar
figural imagery stacked in a vertical sequence down the face
schematic outline forms raised from a flat ground
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief figures arranged one above another down the length of a tall vertical slab, and both reduce their subjects to simple raised outlines with little interior modelling. But the depicted subjects differ completely: A shows quadrupeds and a long-legged bird-like creature in strict profile with no human element, while B shows a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with a rayed head, splayed hands, and flanking crescent motifs.
